title.narrative: Support to the Permanent Interstate Committee for Drought Control in the Sahel (CILSS)

description.narrative: The mandate or general objective guiding the action of CILSS is to invest in the search for food security and in the fight against the effects of drought and desertification, for a new ecological balance in the Sahel through: 1) Formulation, analysis, coordination and harmonization of strategies and policies; 2) Strengthening scientific and technical cooperation; 3) Collection, processing and dissemination of information; 4) Capacity building of the various actors, including the private sector; 5) Capitalization and dissemination of experiences and acquired; 6) Support in the implementation of strategies, policies and programs.
